stem: Candice needs a topic sentence for the third paragraph (sentences 19–21). Which of the following sentences should be inserted before sentence 19 to introduce the ideas in this paragraph?

options.label: A
options.text: Over time a vast array of creatures has come to inhabit the Great Barrier Reef.

options.label: B
options.text: Marine animal species that are threatened are protected by the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority.

options.label: C
options.text: The biodiversity of the Great Barrier Reef ensures its long-term existence.

options.label: D
options.text: The waters along the Great Barrier Reef provide a habitat for marine animals that researchers study.
